snippet.title: Amakta Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Amakta, our new game, will be released on Steam the August 1st, 2025!

Amakta is a simultaneous turn based strategy board game. Outwit your oppenent, either a friend locally, a Steam friend online or the AI.

Whishlist now!
